en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Musna Al Hannat, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who went out with a bird, from Makkah to Al-Kufa. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should return it to Makkah’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Muthanna’ al-Hannat from Zurarah who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about a man who leaves Makkah with a bird for al-Kufah. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must return it to Makkah.’”
